messages.content: Prove the following statement. Explain the assumptions and decisive steps. You may use standard theorems, but derive any nontrivial configuration-specific fact rather than citing a name alone. In an acute triangle ABC with AB≠AC, let H be the orthocenter, M the midpoint of BC, E the foot from B to AC, and F the foot from C to AB. Let T=EF∩BC. Prove HT is perpendicular to AM. Write the entire proof in English.

Prove the following statement. Explain the assumptions and decisive steps. You may use standard theorems, but derive any nontrivial configuration-specific fact rather than citing a name alone. In an acute triangle ABC with AB≠AC, let E be the foot from B to AC, F the foot from C to AB, and N the midpoint of BC. A circle through A,E is tangent at A to line AF, and a circle through A,F is tangent at A to line AE. Let X be their intersection other than A. Prove A,N,X are collinear. Write the entire proof in English.

Prove the following statement. Explain the assumptions and decisive steps. You may use standard theorems, but derive any nontrivial configuration-specific fact rather than citing a name alone. In an acute triangle ABC with AB≠AC, let H be the orthocenter, M the midpoint of BC, and P the foot from H to line AM. Prove B,C,H,P are concyclic. Write the entire proof in English.
